guidance.bestFor: A plain invoice list with a caption under the rows, a payment method column and status written as text

whenNotToUse.when: A list that closes with a totals row under the records

guidance.bestFor: A footer row whose Total label spans 2 columns beside a bold sum of the amounts
agentNotes: The `TableFooter` total is the literal $750.00, not a sum of `invoices`; compute it from your rows

whenNotToUse.when: A caption under the rows and a payment method column, with no sum

name: c-table-3
title: Table in card with status badges.
label: Status Badges
description: Table in card with status badges.

guidance.bestFor: A 2 column task list set inside a Card, with a colored status pill right aligned on each row
agentNotes: Status pills are spans colored by fixed green, yellow and gray classes in `statusColor`, with no dark mode shades

guidance.bestFor: A dots button on each product row that opens Edit, Duplicate and a destructive Delete
agentNotes: Edit, Duplicate and Delete are bare `DropdownMenuItem` entries with no handler; wire each to `product.id`

guidance.bestFor: A number input in each row for changing a quantity in place, inside a Card
agentNotes: Quantity `Input` fields are uncontrolled through `defaultValue`, and the `price` cell never changes with them
Each quantity `Input` has no accessible name; label it with the row's `name`

whenNotToUse.when: Many editable cells with keyboard moves between them and copy and paste

name: c-table-6
title: Team members table with avatars, roles, and status
label: Team Members
description: Team members table with avatars, roles, and status

guidance.bestFor: Team members with avatar, name and email over role and presence badges, inside a Frame panel
agentNotes: Badge colors come from the `roleVariant` and `statusVariant` fields on each entry of `members`, not from the role text

whenNotToUse.when: A member directory the admin searches, sorts and pages

name: c-table-7
title: Orders table with customer info and payment status
label: Orders
description: Orders table with customer info and payment status

guidance.bestFor: Recent orders with a monospace order number, a customer name over the order date beside an avatar, and a right aligned amount
agentNotes: Each order's `email` is never rendered; the line under the customer name is `date`

name: c-table-8
title: Projects table with team avatars and status
label: Projects
description: Projects table with team avatars and status

guidance.bestFor: Projects with a folder icon tile, stacked team avatars plus an overflow count and a due date
agentNotes: `AvatarGroupCount` prints the `extra` field as given; derive it from your real team size
Each `AvatarImage` takes its alt from the `fallback` initials; pass the member's full name

name: c-table-9
title: Activity log table with user avatars and timestamps
label: Activity Log
description: Activity log table with user avatars and timestamps

guidance.bestFor: An audit trail of who did what, with an action badge, a monospace target such as a branch and a relative time
agentNotes: Rows are keyed by array `index`; key them by an event id once new entries can be prepended
`timestamp` holds fixed strings such as 2 minutes ago; format your event times into relative text

name: c-table-10
title: Subscriptions table with plan badges and billing info
label: Subscriptions
description: Subscriptions table with plan badges and billing info

guidance.bestFor: Software subscriptions with a plan badge, monthly price, next billing date and a Manage button on each row
agentNotes: The Manage `Button` has no handler; route it to that row's billing settings

name: c-table-11
title: Product inventory table with stock badges and prices
label: Inventory
description: Product inventory table with stock badges and prices

guidance.bestFor: Products with a SKU under the name, a stock level badge beside the unit count and an Edit, Restock, Archive menu
agentNotes: `stockStatus` and `stockVariant` are set by hand next to `stock`; derive both from the count so they cannot disagree
Edit, Restock and Archive are `DropdownMenuItem` entries with no handler yet

name: c-table-12
title: API keys table with permission badges and actions
label: API Keys
description: API keys table with permission badges and actions

guidance.bestFor: Masked secret keys in a code chip, with xs permission badges and icon buttons to copy or regenerate
agentNotes: Copy key and Regenerate key are icon `Button` elements with no handler yet
`permissionVariant` maps read, write and admin to badge colors; any other scope falls back to outline

name: c-table-13
title: File manager table with owners and sharing badges
label: File Manager
description: File manager table with owners and sharing badges

guidance.bestFor: Files and folders with a type icon, owner avatar, a sharing scope badge, size and last modified time
agentNotes: Each record in `files` stores its own `IconPlaceholder` element in `icon`; pick the icon from the file type instead

whenNotToUse.when: Document icons resolved from each name or MIME format, with a colored extension label

name: c-table-14
title: Issues table with priority, assignee, and labels
label: Issues
description: Issues table with priority, assignee, and labels

guidance.bestFor: Issue rows with a monospace ID, a title followed by an outline label badge, the assignee and a status badge
agentNotes: `priority`, `priorityIcon` and `priorityVariant` sit on each issue but are never rendered; add a cell to show them
Every label renders as an outline `Badge`, so `labelVariant` on each issue is unused

whenNotToUse.when: Issues moved between status columns by drag and drop

name: c-table-15
title: Leaderboard table with rank, score, and level badges
label: Leaderboard
description: Leaderboard table with rank, score, and level badges

guidance.bestFor: A ranked list with a position number, player handle, level badge, formatted score and a colored up or down change
agentNotes: `score` goes through `toLocaleString` with no locale argument, so server and browser can print different separators
`changeUp` picks the trend icon and color by hand; set it from the sign of `change`

name: c-table-16
title: Vertical table with employee profile details
label: Employee Profile
description: Vertical table with employee profile details

guidance.bestFor: One employee's details as label and value rows, with a shaded label column, avatar, job title and status
agentNotes: Labels are `TableCell` cells, not row headers; switch them to `TableHead` with scope row for screen readers
Every value is a literal in the JSX; map your record's fields into `TableRow` entries
The email cell is `text-primary` text with no link; wrap it in a mailto anchor if it should open mail

whenNotToUse.when: A titled panel of machine specs with usage meters and tag badges

name: c-table-17
title: Vertical table with server configuration details
label: Server Config
description: Vertical table with server configuration details

guidance.bestFor: A titled server panel with a pulsing status dot, CPU and memory usage bars and secondary tag badges
agentNotes: The CPU and memory bars are plain divs whose inline `width` is hardcoded at 42% and 67%; drive it from your metrics
The pulsing status dot uses fixed green classes with `animate-ping` and no reduced motion guard
Each label sits in a `TableCell`, so screen readers get no row header; a `TableHead` with scope row fixes that

whenNotToUse.when: A person's record with a photo, job title and contact email
